text:
Devon: Starting a low-risk canary for inference-service v2.15.0 in ~5m, canary=7%. Maya: I’ll take smoke checks and report every 8-10m. Liam: Infra standby for rollback; I’ve prepped the v2.14.x tag and drain script. deploy-bot: Job deploy-1855001234 started — image=redwood/inference:v2.15.0, canary=7%.

Maya: Canary instances up at 09:04 PT. Running quick health and generate probes.

Maya: health checks:
```
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://inference.redwood.ai/health -> 200 0.033s
curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}s" https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/generate -> 200 0.205s
```
Ran 5 synthetic prompts against canary pool: all returned expected JSON (id, choices, usage). No stack traces in logs for sampled request ids.

Maya: Prom snapshot (canary): p50=90ms, p95=260ms, p99=410ms. Error rate=0.11% (baseline 0.05%). Logging a small cluster of 429s on one replica.

Anika: 429s could be transient throttling from a new batching heuristic. Any kv-cache warnings or batch-size logs?

Maya: Found repeated "batching: flush timeout" on one pod. Restarted that pod; 429s cleared. After restart p99=395ms.

Liam: Scaled canary node pool +1 to reduce pod density. No node-level alerts; disk and memory healthy. Rollback artifacts ready.

Devon: Rolling criteria: sustained error rate >0.9% for 5m OR p50 >550ms for 5m OR structured-output mismatch. If triggered, rollback to v2.14.8. Liam, be ready to roll.

Maya: I’ll post a follow-up at +10m with a detailed snapshot. Current state looks stable. Saving traces for a couple of sampled ids in case Sentry follow-up needed.

deploy-bot: Canary at 7% for 9m — no auto-rollback conditions met.

Maya: 09:14 PT update: p50=95ms, p95=275ms, p99=420ms, errors 0.09% over last 10m. No new exceptions; synthetics OK.

Anika: Noted a GC pause spike on svc-canary-3 around 09:12; correlates with the pod restart. No further GC chatter.

Devon: OK to ramp to 30% if metrics hold for the next 10m. After ramp we’ll watch 15m. Keep this thread as the source of truth for rollout status.

Liam: Increasing traffic to 30% now. Rolling update in progress.

deploy-bot: Traffic ramp to 30% complete — canary now at 30% (deploy-1855001234).

Maya: 09:30 PT post-ramp check: p50=120ms, p95=320ms, p99=480ms, errors 0.22%. Slight uptick but within ramp tolerances. No user-visible failures. Monitoring 15m.

Devon: Thanks team. If stable we’ll proceed to full roll in phases. I’ll hold final sign-off until the 15m post-ramp snapshot.

Maya: Will post the 15m verdict here. :white_check_mark:
